notes:
{仕分|しわ}け refers to sorting, classification, or accounting entries.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {仕|し}: To do
- ⟦{分|わ}け→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: Division, separation

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1: Physical or conceptual sorting (mail, packages, budgets)
- Sense 2: Accounting term for journal entries

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕分|しわ}け⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (sorting work)
- {仕分|しわ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sort)
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕分|しわ}け (garbage sorting)
- ⟦{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}→郵便物：18044_yuubinbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕分|しわ}け (mail sorting)
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕分|しわ}け (expense journal entries)

POLITICAL CONTEXT:
- {事業仕分|じぎょうしわ}け became famous in 2009 when the DPJ government publicly reviewed government spending
- The phrase "{仕分|しわ}け⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧" (budget reviewer) entered popular use

ACCOUNTING CONTEXT:
- In bookkeeping, {仕分|しわ}け refers to recording transactions as debits and credits
- ⟦{仕訳|しわけ}→仕訳：29754_shiwake⟧ (alternative kanji) is also used in accounting

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧ (classification - more formal)
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける→振り分ける：08218_furiwakeru⟧ (to distribute)
- ⟦{選別|せんべつ}→選別：09616_senbetsu⟧ (sorting, selection)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in business and daily life.
